proof: V46 imports and calls apply_startup_status_cleanup.apply as agent_server_apply, then compiles server_after_agent.
The current canonical Agent wrapper explicitly applies apply_tombstone_wiring after base_wiring.materialize and requires exactly one subagent-uncertain-tasks.json marker.
apply_startup_status_cleanup.py contains no subagent-uncertain-tasks.json marker; that marker is introduced by apply_subagent_tombstone_wiring.py.
Therefore V46 isolated composed server bytes do not represent the current canonical Agent tombstone-path wiring.

The canonical Agent wrapper cannot simply be run after V46: base_wiring.materialize re-invokes the exact-source Agent transforms, while apply_startup_status_cleanup requires the frozen old server blob that V46 has already transformed.
